verdict.rationale: Inside the product, cubic generates AI suggestions and insights from the user's code and PR data. This includes review comments on bugs and improvements, a context-aware chat sidebar that can "tour this PR", AI-generated PR descriptions, and an AI wiki that indexes the codebase with architecture diagrams. Its analytics dashboard, however, only presents metrics. Nothing shows AI-generated insights over that usage and delivery data. Community comments on suggestion quality are mixed but do not concretely contradict the capability. missing for 10: AI-generated insights over the analytics/team data (the dashboard is metrics-only per the evidence), independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Comments on bugs and improvements in pull requests
The chat sidebar helps you quickly understand and navigate your pull requests (PRs) with intelligent, context-aware assistance directly within cubic.
cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes your codebase and produces searchable wikis, complete with links to source code, architecture diagrams, and more.
